new_today_news.headline: Route optimization trends for trash pickup
new_today_news.summary: Analysis of how waste collection route optimization is being reshaped by operational software, municipal requirements, and neighborhood constraints. Discusses summer collection challenges, access issues, and container management practices affecting service delivery.

backfill_news.headline: Efficient Grease Collection for Food Service: Best Practices and Benefits
backfill_news.summary: Article on best practices for grease collection in food service, covering legal requirements, regulatory compliance, and converting grease waste into revenue streams through recycling partnerships. Focuses on efficient collection processes and profitability while supporting environmental sustainability.
